title: Ecuador's 2008 constitution: the rights of nature
goal: Comment on the 2008 constitution and the rights of nature with el hecho de que.
grammar: el hecho de que with the subjunctive

items: I can comment on a known fact with *el hecho de que* + subjunctive (Ecuador).
I can say how the 2008 constitution was approved and what it says about nature.
I can use the new words for law: *referéndum*, *juez*, *asamblea*, *derecho*.
